description:
The review-required soundness surface in `_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py`
(`SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES`, lines 11-15: `benchbox/core/equivalence/`,
`benchbox/core/query_plans/parsers/`, plus the `benchbox/core/**/validation.py`
regex) is mirrored 1:1 in `.github/CODEOWNERS`. It covers the comparator and
plan-parser code paths but omits several oracle-adjacent assets that define or
feed "correct" for the same soundness checks:

- `benchbox/core/expected_results/**` — the reference-value loader
  (`benchbox/core/expected_results/loader.py`), registry, and the
  hash-pinned digest fixtures themselves (e.g.
  `benchbox/core/expected_results/reference_digests/tpch_value_digests_sf1.json`).
  A PR editing that JSON digest file today auto-merges with zero review, even
  though it silently redefines what counts as a correct TPC-H result.
- `benchbox/sql_compat/**` — semantic query rewrites (rule registrations under
  `benchbox/sql_compat/rules/`) that can change what SQL is actually executed
  against a platform without touching the comparator itself. High-churn: most
  files here are per-platform DDL/query-rewrite rules added routinely, so a
  blanket prefix would create real merge friction.
- `benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py` — houses
  `validate_loaded_data` / `validate_row_counts`, which delegate to
  `ValidationService` / `DataValidator`, and the plan-capture pipeline
  (`get_query_plan_parser`, `capture_query_plan`) that feeds the parsers in
  `benchbox/core/query_plans/parsers/`. Currently outside the soundness set.
- `_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py` itself, and the workflows
  that define or invoke the gate (`.github/workflows/auto-merge-on-open.yml`,
  `pr.yml`, `release.yml`) — a PR editing the predicate or the workflow that
  runs it can currently weaken its own gate without triggering owner review.
  (This last point overlaps with auto-merge-predicate-base-ref-execution;
  see deps below — do not implement self-protection in both places.)

anti_patterns.dont: add benchbox/sql_compat/ wholesale without recording the churn tradeoff
anti_patterns.why: grep git log for recent commit volume under that tree before deciding, since it is explicitly called out as high-churn in the description.

anti_patterns.dont: implement the workflow/predicate self-protection here AND in auto-merge-predicate-base-ref-execution
anti_patterns.why: pick one owner for that concern (see deps.needs there) to avoid duplicated or conflicting logic.

anti_patterns.dont: widen SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES without updating .github/CODEOWNERS in the same commit
anti_patterns.why: they are asserted to match by test_codeowners_covers_soundness_paths, and a mismatch means require_code_owner_review silently does nothing for the new paths.

preserves.behavior: The existing equivalence/, query_plans/parsers/, and **/validation.py coverage in SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES is unchanged (only additive widening).
auto-merge-on-open.yml, make pr-open, and CODEOWNERS continue to read from the single SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES source of truth — no second hardcoded copy of the path list is introduced.
tests/unit/test_auto_merge_soundness_paths.py stays green (updated, not skipped or weakened).

prior_art.concept: .github/CODEOWNERS — mirrors SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES 1:1 today; must stay in lockstep with any change here.
_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py:SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES — the single source of truth being widened; keep it the only place the prefix tuple is defined.

_project/scripts/ruleset_review_enforcement.py:SOUNDNESS_PATH_GLOBS — narration derived from SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES for the review-enforcement predicate; will pick up new prefixes automatically once SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES changes, but double-check the printed glob list still reads sensibly.

tests/unit/test_auto_merge_soundness_paths.py:test_codeowners_covers_soundness_paths — the pinned unit test asserting CODEOWNERS lines match the predicate; update it alongside the prefix change, do not let it silently start failing.

verifications.description: Soundness-path predicate unit tests pass with the widened set, including new true/false cases for expected_results and result_capture.py
A PR path under the new prefixes is classified as soundness=true

work_units.notes:
Recommend at minimum: benchbox/core/expected_results/ (all of it — the
loader, registry, and digest fixtures together define correctness) and
benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py (single file, low churn). For
benchbox/sql_compat/, weigh whether to include the whole tree (high churn,
most edits are routine per-platform rule additions) versus a narrower
subset — e.g. only benchbox/sql_compat/rules/_registration.py and
benchbox/sql_compat/resolver.py/decision.py (the rule-dispatch core, where
a bug silently changes which rewrites apply) rather than every
rules/*_rewrites.py leaf. Decide and record the reasoning in the PR
description; do not widen sql_compat/ wholesale without weighing the
friction tradeoff explicitly.
work_units.summary: Decide the widened prefix/glob set, weighing review friction against oracle coverage

work_units.notes:
Edit _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py:SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES and
.github/CODEOWNERS together in the same commit. Update
tests/unit/test_auto_merge_soundness_paths.py's parametrized
is_soundness_path cases (both matching and non-matching) and
test_codeowners_covers_soundness_paths to reflect the new set. Run the
full test file, not just the new cases, to catch regressions in the
existing equivalence/parsers/validation.py coverage.
work_units.summary: Update SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES and CODEOWNERS in lockstep; keep the pinning test green

work_units.notes:
SOUNDNESS_PATH_GLOBS in _project/scripts/ruleset_review_enforcement.py is
derived from SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES, so no code change should be needed, but
run its CLI against a fixture to eyeball that the expanded glob list in
its FAILED/OK output still reads clearly (it's user-facing text in the
runbook verify command's output).
work_units.summary: Update ruleset_review_enforcement.py's narration and confirm it renders correctly
